import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut


def dimuon_mask(events, params, **kwargs):
    """Event-level mask: >=2 muons above pT threshold with an opposite-charge leading pair."""
    muons = events.Muon
    good_muons = muons[muons.pt > params["pt_threshold"]]

    at_least_two_muons = ak.num(good_muons, axis=1) >= 2

    padded_muons = ak.pad_none(good_muons, 2, axis=1)
    leading_muon = padded_muons[:, 0]
    subleading_muon = padded_muons[:, 1]
    opposite_charge = (leading_muon.charge * subleading_muon.charge) < 0

    mask = at_least_two_muons & opposite_charge
    return ak.fill_none(mask, False)


dimuon = Cut(
    name="dimuon",
    params={"pt_threshold": 15},
    function=dimuon_mask,
)
